name: Taiyabah Masjid
_note: One masjid on the screen. Everything here is optional except id, name and timetables: a masjid with no give block simply shows no donation QR, one with no appeal shows no appeal link. That is how a masjid joins without having to supply things it does not have.

stream.name: Taiyabah Masjid
stream.note: Shoutcast, 128kbps MP3. IMPORTANT: this is the /stream.mp3 endpoint, not the bare host the website links to. The bare host returns audio/mpeg but browsers reject it with a format error, so it plays in a desktop media player and fails silently in the app. Verified playing at ~1.2s to first audio.

give.giftAidNote: If you're a UK taxpayer, please add Gift Aid — it adds 25p to every £1 at no cost to you.
give.note: Bolton Central Islamic Society · Registered charity 1041569.
give.qrNote: qrUrl is what the on-screen QR encodes. Point it at a Stripe Payment Link when one exists — fewer steps than the shop page and it brings Apple/Google Pay, which is most of the conversion win on a phone. After changing it run tools/make-qr.py; build.py fails if the QR and this URL disagree.

appeal.heading: Building a lasting home for Taiyabah Masjid.
appeal.tagline: A purpose-built centre for prayer, learning and community life — designed with the community, funded by the community.
appeal.phaseDescription: Help make the masjid ready for salah, Qur'an and remembrance for generations to come.
